 Order
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

CRL.M.C. 938/2026, CRL.M.A. 3726/2026 (exemption from filing of copy of the chargesheet) &
CRL.M.A. 3723/2026 (stay)
2.
Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 80/2025 of Police Station Chankakyapuri for offence under Section 498A/406 IPC on merits.
Apart from that, there are large numbers of reliefs sought in the petition, which prima facie, cannot be allowed in the present proceedings.
Learned counsel for petitioners seeks passover awaiting the arguing counsel.
But it already being 03:10pm, in view of a pending heavy board, passover is not possible.
Learned counsel is unable to explain about maintainability of such petition for the abovementioned reliefs other than quashing.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 04/02/2026 at 20:40:39 3.
Relist on 24.03.2026 in Advance List, as specifically requested according to convenience of arguing counsel.
GIRISH KATHPALIA, J FEBRUARY 4, 2026/as This is a digitally signed order.
